artworks.title: The Anger of Achilles
artworks.description: David's neoclassical quarrel: Achilles reaches for his sword as Agamemnon's heralds claim Briseis — the prize that starts the wrath of the Iliad.

artworks.title: Eurybates and Talthybius Lead Briseis to Agamemnon
artworks.description: Tiepolo's Venetian draft of the seizure: heralds escort Briseis from Achilles' tent — the Iliad's insult painted as airy, cruel pageantry.

artworks.title: Briseis Given Back to Achilles
artworks.description: Rubens' Detroit oil sketch: Briseis returns to Achilles after Patroclus' death — the prize restored too late, flesh and drapery in baroque rush.

artworks.title: The Departure of Briseis
artworks.description: Deshays stages Briseis leaving Achilles' camp — the captive between tents and heralds, the quarrel's human cost before David's sharper geometry.

artworks.title: Briseis Mourning Patroclus
artworks.description: Alaux's Salon grief: Briseis weeps over Patroclus in Achilles' tent — Homer's captive given a voice of mourning in neoclassical quiet.

artifacts.title: Achilles and Briseis
artifacts.description: Pompeian wall painting: Briseis is led away from Achilles' tent while the hero turns aside — the Iliad's quarrel frozen in Roman domestic space.

films.title: Troy
films.description: Rose Byrne's Briseis is the captive who softens Achilles and sharpens Agamemnon's insult — the film's face of the quarrel that keeps the Greeks from victory.

films.title: The Fury of Achilles
films.description: Italian peplum retells the wrath from Briseis' seizure onward — the prize of Lyrnessus as the spark that pulls Achilles from the war.

films.title: Troy: Fall of a City
films.description: The BBC/Netflix saga keeps Briseis in Achilles' orbit — the captive whose taking and return still drive the Greek camp's politics.

popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Homer's fair-cheeked captive is the quarrel's object: when Agamemnon takes Briseis, Achilles withdraws, and the war itself hangs on a woman's name.
